capabilities: Show notes from multiple folders on a calendar
Group note sources into separate calendar views
Open or create a day's note by clicking its source indicator
Build note paths from brace-wrapped moment-style date templates
Export and import settings as JSON
disambiguation: Not a collaboration or shared-note tool; it only displays and creates notes on calendars.
extras: Holiday data is fetched and cached by year; failed requests fall back to weekend rules without affecting calendar or note features. Holidays are disabled by default.
intentEvidence: Instead of being limited to a single daily note location, you can define multiple note sources
motivation: The author keeps personal daily notes and AI-generated notes in separate folders and wanted to compare the same day across both without blurring which record came from whom.
problem: Obsidian's daily notes live in one folder, so parallel note systems such as personal and AI-written journals cannot be compared day by day.

relations.evidence: China uses holiday-cn, including public holidays and adjusted workdays.
Other countries use nationwide public holidays from Nager.Date.

summary: Calendar plugin that shows notes from several folders as color-coded indicators on each day, opening or creating the note when clicked.
